title: Cardinal of Como (papal Secretariat) to Anselmo Dandini, nuncio in France, Rome, 8 August 1580 (ASV Segr. Stato Francia 283C ff. 89r-90r, DECODE R73)

steps.what: DECODE R72-R73 metadata, page images of R72, DOC images and DOC text files fetched with the session cookie; Lasry's key and his R73 decryption found on the records (filed under R72).
Lasry's R73 decryption (D3191) read and summarised: a princely marriage negotiation, then the King and the nun.

Split from the former combined target dandini1580 (catalogue 244) under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R73 is read with Lasry's key D3190; R72 uses a different letter assignment in the same frame and stays dandini1580. Lasry's decryption and KaJo's transcription moved here; measure_r73.py counts 1,040 of 1,082 groups with a value (96.1%).

R73 page images (IMG_R73_I576-I578, ff. 89r-90r) fetched with the cookie; the record's DOC images reread: ff. 88/92 are Como's covering letter of 8 Aug 1580 ('Con mezzo foglio di Cifra'), f. 91 a clear copy headed 'Cifra ... con l're di 8 agosto 80'.
f. 91 compared by eye with Lasry's decryption of the f. 90r section: the same text line for line; differences N.S.re / M.S., darle / parlio, regina madre / <744^>.

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry recovered the key (D3190) and decrypted R73 (D3191) on DECODE in 2020; the project measured his decryption and found a contemporary clear copy of its second section on f. 91, which agrees with it; nothing re-decrypted here.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/dandini1580r73/measure_r73.py on Lasry's decryption file: cipher groups; '?', unread nomenclator <NNN^> and values marked with '?' count as unread

gaps.detail: damaged paper and bleed-through; the transcription marks them '?'
one occurrence each; no clear copy of the f. 89r section; not filled by Lasry

outcome.notes: Read by Lasry; 96.1% of groups have a value in his file. Date and the f. 91 clear copy found here 14 Oct 2026.

credits.note: key D3190 recovered and R73 decrypted (D3191), on DECODE
clear copy of the f. 90r section on f. 91 ('Cifra ... con l're di 8 agosto 80'), used as a check

prior.where: DECODE R72/R73: Lasry's key D3190 and decryption D3191 (Oct 2020); contemporary clear copy of the f. 90r section on f. 91 (R73 attachment)

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
